items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: that was where Kalikawa meets (?) and Waikiki.

ctx.x: his orchestra), and I can't remember the trumpet player's name... Anyway, we went to Honolulu. This was in the same year, 1947, late in the year. Trummy stayed in Honolulu until he joined Louis years later. But I think my total stay was about three years. I played in the Honolulu Symphony under Barati, and I had my own band in a place called Lai Yi Chai's, that was where Kalikawa meets (?) and Waikiki. Trummy had a band in the Brown Derby. I've already mentioned the names of the band somewhere back there, didn't…

Anyhow, that was fun. I already mentioned this. I used to do one arrangement a day, and that's how I built my library. These guys were just beautiful people to work with. it was the first time I'd worked with a real international band. They were good musicians, too.
